Short version: we can offer a targeted onboarding credit plus a one-time reduction on the VPC packaging fee, but I need internal sign-off for anything beyond a limited one-time concession. My recommended commercial structure (to get you started quickly):

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Samir's note and the SOW. Quick context and recommendation below.

Context: Nebula Diagnostics is a mid-market healthcare analytics prospect (expected ARR ~$220k first year if pilot converts). They require VPC (PHI-risk environment) and are price sensitive this quarter. Procurement asked for 30% onboarding credit + full packaging waiver.

Commercial ask: 30% onboarding credit on first 6 months + full VPC package waiver (approx $30k).

My recommended concession: authorize up to 25% onboarding credit and a one-time VPC packaging reduction capped at $12,500 (net impact ~ $67.5k gross list reduction over first period). Conditions: 12-month committed term, PO within 30 days, pilot scope limited to 3 model endpoints, Redwood audit log access enabled.

Rationale: healthcare vertical, potential to expand into multi-model pipelines and Dedicated capacity next year; customer is willing to commit to 12 months and provide joint marketing reference if pilot succeeds.

Attachments: nebula_pricing_workbook.xlsx (xlsx) — includes uplift sensitivity & ARR math.

Please advise if you approve the recommended concession, or if VP/CFO approval needed to reach 30% / full packaging waiver. If approved I will send final SOW + DocuSign link to Samir.

Olga / Marissa — reviewed the workbook. Approve a one-time exception with the following firm boundaries:
1) Onboarding credit: 25% credit on invoice line items for the first 6 months (applies to token usage + prompt engineering hours).
2) VPC packaging: one-time waiver reduced to a credit not to exceed $12,500.
3) Customer must sign a 12-month committed term and provide PO within 30 days of DocuSign execution.
4) Require standard audit access clause added to SOW and a clause limiting credit forfeiture if customer terminates early.

Rationale: protects revenue while giving sales enough flexibility to close. If Nebula requests more than 25% or full packaging waiver beyond $12.5k escalate to CFO (Marissa please confirm if you want me to take to CFO or if you will).
